cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.whatBody: Cookies are small text files that a website saves in your browser. They are needed for correct operation, safety and convenience.
cookies.howTitle: How does the site use cookies?
cookies.howCart: Cart: added items are stored in the cart (for anonymous users via a session ID cookie).
cookies.howAuth: Sign-in (auth): used to recognize you after sign-in and securely store refresh tokens (for example, refreshToken).
cookies.howCsrf: Security (CSRF): the token is passed via cookie to protect requests from forged sites.
cookies.manageBody: You can delete or restrict cookies in your browser settings. If cookies are disabled, cart features (in anonymous mode), automatic sign-in, and some security functions may not work fully.
